description: Return what GitHub actually charged for Actions, read from GitHub's billing usage API by the CI collector once a day (or pushed with `mushi runner bill --push`). Unlike get_ci_costs, these money figures are measured, not estimated. Returns { window, previousWindow, provenance: "measured", currency: "USD", available, repoScoped (true when you are not a member of the organization: only your projects' repos are shown), unavailableReason (why there is no bill and how to connect one), owners [{ owner, ownerType, lastOkAt, lastAttemptAt, lastError, lastSource (api | cli), coveredFrom }], month { label, grossUsd, discountUsd, netUsd } (this calendar month so far), totals { grossUsd, discountUsd, netUsd, minutes }, previousTotals and change { netUsd, netPct } (null unless Mushi holds the whole previous period), windowComplete, byRepo [{ repo, netUsd, grossUsd, discountUsd, minutes }], bySku, byDay (every day of the window), dataThrough, agentShare { share, billedMinutes, agentBilledMinutes, branches, provenance: "estimated" } (paid GitHub-hosted minutes on Mushi agent branches, from the jobs Mushi recorded) }. Net is what was charged; public repos and included minutes show as discount. Optional projectId (default: the configured project; an account-level key with none reads every project) and days (1-90, default 30). Read-only.

projectId.description: Project UUID — defaults to the server-configured project; omitted with an account-level key, every project you can read (`project_id` is accepted too.)
